label: ATMO v5 forecast
description: ATMO v5 zarr runs on S3 into 10-band COG TIFFs, wind-particle .bin files and the Redis point cache. Ported from panahon-nwp (branch v1.2).

find_run.label: Find and claim run
find_run.description: Halts unless a complete, unclaimed run is on S3. Prepares the grid, creates the model_forecasts row and emits the run with its batches. Connections: ATMO_S3, NWP_DB.

args.name: model
args.description: nwp_models.model_name to publish as; also the folder and file prefix (upper-cased).

args.name: work_dir
args.description: Staging folder holding one folder per run. Must be the same shared path for every atmo node.

args.name: steps
args.description: 15-minute frames to process, starting at 0.

args.name: batch_size
args.description: Frames per batch; 96 is one forecast day.

args.name: run
args.description: Process this run folder instead of the newest, e.g. v5-20261113_180000.

args.name: stalled_minutes
args.description: Re-claim a started run that recorded no frame for this long.

rain_total.label: Running rain total
rain_total.description: Downloads every precipitation chunk of the run and writes the running total each frame's TPRATE band uses. Re-emits the run manifest. Connections: ATMO_S3.

args.name: run_json
args.description: run.json written by find_run.

frames.label: Build a batch of frames
frames.description: For each frame in the batch: download chunks, build the COG TIFF and (with GRIB2JSON_BIN) the wind .bin. Finished frames are skipped on retry. Connections: ATMO_S3.

args.name: model
args.description: nwp_models.model_name to publish as; also the folder and file prefix (upper-cased).

args.name: work_dir
args.description: Staging folder holding one folder per run. Must be the same shared path for every atmo node.

args.name: workers
args.description: Frames built at the same time.

record_frames.label: Record delivered frames
record_frames.description: Writes the batch's model_forecast_tiffs / wind rows to the ETL database, idempotently. Connections: NWP_DB, NWP_PUBLIC.

args.name: frames_json
args.description: Batch file written by frames.

args.name: public_prefix
args.description: Folder of the NWP tree inside the delivery disk.

args.name: public_url
args.description: URL of the NWP tree. Default: the disk's own URL, else copied from another model's file_url.

point_cache.label: Point cache (Redis)
point_cache.description: build: load a finished run's TIFFs into the Redis point cache. delete / exists: maintenance. Connections: REDIS.

args.name: model
args.description: nwp_models.model_name to publish as; also the folder and file prefix (upper-cased).

args.name: work_dir
args.description: Staging folder holding one folder per run (build).

args.name: tiff_dir
args.description: Read the TIFFs from here instead of the staging run folder.

args.name: quarter_hour_span_hours
args.description: Every 15-minute frame for this many hours, then hourly.

args.name: ttl
args.description: Seconds a key lives.

finish_run.label: Finish run and prune
finish_run.description: Marks the run completed and cached, removes its staging folder and prunes runs beyond keep-runs. Connections: NWP_DB, REDIS, NWP_PUBLIC.

args.name: model
args.description: nwp_models.model_name to publish as; also the folder and file prefix (upper-cased).

args.name: work_dir
args.description: Staging folder holding one folder per run. Must be the same shared path for every atmo node.

args.name: keep_runs
args.description: Completed runs kept.

args.name: public_prefix
args.description: Folder of the NWP tree inside the delivery disk.
